svg.title: Outcome mix, A vs B
svg.desc: How do the two outcome mixes differ on the same tasks? tokens-0: haiku ts-off 65%, haiku ts-on 58% passed; tokens-25000: haiku ts-off 62%, haiku ts-on 56% passed; tokens-50000: haiku ts-off 59%, haiku ts-on 59% passed; tokens-100000: haiku ts-off 63%, haiku ts-on 55% passed; tokens-200000: haiku ts-off 59%, haiku ts-on 56% passed; all runs: haiku ts-off 62%, haiku ts-on 57% passed

g.text: The same shared tasks under each side: pass on the left, failures grow from the right edge, worst last. Bars of one
run are aligned, so a longer segment is more of that outcome.
